content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIM Kozhikode Senior Advisor (Development) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 30-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Kozhikode to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IIM Kozhikode Senior Advisor (Development) position is 30 September 2026.

faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Senior Advisor (Development) post at IIM Kozhikode.

faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is Graduation in any stream. Additionally, 10-15 years of leadership experience in specific fields is necessary.

faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 65 years.

faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on an Interview.

faq.answer: The application process for the IIM Kozhikode Senior Advisor (Development) recruitment is strictly online.
